text.title: Activation Metrics Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the weekly activation metrics report: one activation event and window, a signup period closed before the data cutoff, the signup total that is the denominator, `metrics[]` with snake_case names and units from ratio / count / days / hours / pp (aggregate `activation_rate` plus `activation_rate__<channel>` per acquisition channel with a low-sample flag against a declared floor, `_partial` for open cohorts), time-to-activation as median plus p75 or p90, an optional D30 lift table with group sizes from a cohort at least 30 days old, a funnel with entering / completing / absolute and relative drop per tracked step, and findings that each cite a metric name and a comparison period. Validator at scripts/validate-activation-metrics.py enforces it, including the denominator, cohort-closure and drop arithmetic.

required.field: the one activation window used by every metric (r-one-fixed-window-closed-cohorts-only)
the date the data was pulled
all users who signed up in the period; the denominator of `activation_rate` (r-activation-rate-denominator-is-signups)
minimum signups a channel segment needs before it is compared (r-segment-by-acquisition-channel)
whether a first-touch channel exists per signup; when true, `activation_rate__<channel>` entries are required (r-segment-by-acquisition-channel)

entries with `name` (snake_case), `value`, `unit` in ratio / count / days / hours / pp, optional `numerator`, `denominator`, `low_sample`; ratios between 0 and 1; must contain `activation_rate` with `denominator` = `signups_total` (r-metric-naming-and-units, r-activation-rate-denominator-is-signups)
`unit` hours or days, `median`, and `p75` or `p90`, over activated users only (r-time-to-activation-uses-quantiles)
ordered steps; instrumented steps with `event`, `entering`, `completing`, `absolute_drop`, `relative_drop`; uninstrumented steps with no numbers (r-funnel-steps-absolute-and-relative)
each with `metric` (a `metrics[].name`), `text` containing that name, `compared_to` period, `causal: false` unless `product_change.ab_test_result` is given (r-findings-cite-metric-and-period)
per candidate event: cohort signup range at least 30 days before the cutoff, `performed` and `not_performed` with `users` and `d30_retention`, `wording: correlation` (r-d30-lift-table-with-sizes)

forbidden.pattern: `period_end` + `window_days` after `data_cutoff`, or an open cohort's rate under a name not ending in `_partial` — open-cohort-dip
`channel_attribution: true` with no `activation_rate__<channel>` metric, or a channel with `denominator` below `sample_floor` and `low_sample` not true — channel-mix-read-as-product-change
`time_to_activation` with `mean` as the only figure, or missing `median` — mean-time-to-activation
a `d30_lift` entry whose `cohort_signup_end` + 30 days is after `data_cutoff`, or without both group sizes — d30-lift-without-sizes
a metric with `unit` outside ratio / count / days / hours / pp, or a ratio outside 0..1 — unitless-metrics
a funnel step with `absolute_drop` not equal to `entering` - `completing`, or an uninstrumented step carrying numbers — r-funnel-steps-absolute-and-relative
a finding whose `text` does not contain its `metric`, or `causal: true` without `product_change.ab_test_result` — r-findings-cite-metric-and-period

list.item: The `activation_rate` entry carries `numerator` and `denominator`, and `denominator` equals `signups_total` (r-activation-rate-denominator-is-signups).
`period_end` + `window_days` is on or before `data_cutoff`; any open cohort appears only under a name ending in `_partial` (r-one-fixed-window-closed-cohorts-only).

With `channel_attribution: true`, one `activation_rate__<channel>` entry per channel exists, and every entry with `denominator` below `sample_floor` has `low_sample: true` (r-segment-by-acquisition-channel).
`time_to_activation` has `median` and `p75` or `p90` in hours or days; `mean` is never alone (r-time-to-activation-uses-quantiles).
Every `d30_lift` entry has both group sizes and a `cohort_signup_end` at least 30 days before `data_cutoff`, worded as correlation (r-d30-lift-table-with-sizes).

Every instrumented funnel step has `absolute_drop` = `entering` - `completing` and `relative_drop` = `absolute_drop` / `entering` to three decimals; uninstrumented steps carry no numbers (r-funnel-steps-absolute-and-relative).
Every metric name is snake_case with a unit from the set; ratios are 0..1; a `pp` metric implies `previous_period` (r-metric-naming-and-units).
Every finding's `text` contains its `metric` name and names its `compared_to` period; `causal: true` only with an A/B test result (r-findings-cite-metric-and-period).
